protocol: Fresh same-owner source-informed problems authored after revision fe1eb5299c62a15800015a1bb430171bf6559dc3. Round 1 remains published including its failed retry query. These different scientific target families were not used in implementation fixtures or tuning. Not blind or independent; the owner selected existing source-supported mechanisms. No ranking changes will be made from these scores in this upgrade.

cases.query: A tissue stops receiving precursor today, but some precursor already inside can still mature into useful product. What conserved quantity bounds how much more product can appear after feeding stops?
cases.needed_scope: Supplied linear stock/maturation efficiency and decay law; delayed completion depends on actually retained precursor, not continued unpaid feed.

cases.query: Adding more binding arms keeps a rejected molecule attached for longer. If arms that detach can reattach until the very last arm releases, how does that change the time and cost of washing the molecule away?
cases.needed_scope: Independent memoryless arm chain with zero absorbing escape; rebinding can make clearance grow exponentially with arm count, unlike the no-rebinding harmonic law.

cases.query: A binary assembly tree has only logarithmic depth. Each failed join destroys both input fragments and I must remake them. Does the short tree depth also make its total resource demand logarithmic or its worst-case completion time finite?
cases.needed_scope: IID rebuild-on-rejection recursion for expected material cost; neither expected cost nor log depth supplies finite worst-case support or verified-correct yield.

cases.query: A repaired joint supports the target peak load. Can I infer how much work it absorbs before breaking, just from that peak load and the number of load-bearing bonds?
cases.needed_scope: Declared one-scission equal-load model; bond force and bond dissipation are distinct, and minimal density must not be assumed from a strength requirement alone.

cases.query: One population has a higher mean measured output than another. Will every bounded sensor that increases with output rank it higher too, or do I need a stronger comparison of the whole distributions?
cases.needed_scope: First-order stochastic dominance is the right all-increasing-sensors condition; a mean increase alone and external utility do not supply it.

cases.query: An extra measurement sharply narrows the uncertainty of a hidden model parameter. Could it still be worthless for the particular signed combination I need to decide? I want a worked exact example rather than a general slogan.
cases.needed_scope: Exact supplied moment family and signed task; narrower component interval does not imply a narrower task interval.

cases.query: I have a noisy experiment with bounded duration and input dose. Can it reliably decide on which side of a sharp frequency cutoff all of a spectral line lies when the line can approach that cutoff arbitrarily closely?
cases.needed_scope: Finite-horizon/dose and reciprocal lower-bound contract; adjacent point masses are statistically or adversarially indistinguishable under the supplied bounded error, not a universal no-sensing theorem.

cases.query: The external response of a passive component differs from the nominal device by less than tolerance at every frequency in my working band. Is that enough to certify safe internal motion and energy storage, even after arbitrarily long settling?
cases.needed_scope: Small passive input/output residual does not control an internal lightly damped oscillator's steady stroke, energy or diverging settling time.

cases.query: A continuous-state process diffuses along its fibres, while changes of the base state happen only at Poisson jump times. Does arbitrarily long but finite evolution necessarily turn every integrable density into a uniformly bounded density?
cases.needed_scope: Non-atomic base and positive no-jump term preserve concentrated base mass; no finite L1-to-Linfinity smoothing just from the fibre diffusion.
